snippet.title: The Oversight Bureau - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for The Oversight Bureau, a voice-driven dystopian adventure game developed by Iconic Interactive. Players will be placed in an AI rehabilitation center to be trained to be more "appropriate" for society. Submit with your voice to the approved ethics and ideals, or take another path of freedom. The Oversight Bureau is coming soon to PC (Steam).
